ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density white striations and mottling concentrated in the central regions of both lobes, transitioning to solid black at the trailing margins and base; a distinct white patch is visible on the right lobe adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular peaks and valleys along the trailing edge with amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels relative to the edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex curve along the leading margins tapering to narrow distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular high-contrast pixel formations (barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both lobes; approximately 12 units on the right tip and 8 units on the left tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, unaligned high-intensity linear marks (scars) crossing the dark-pigmented regions on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal tips and prominent linear rake marks across the lower-center of the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced parallel white linear striation patterns throughout the pigmented regions of both lobes.
